_comment: Curated Pokemon-type corrections for cards no structured source types. Applied by build_card_reference.py before Pokemon/Trainer classification. Keep minimal; prefer fixing the source snapshots when possible.

records.name: Mega Altaria ex
records.note: TCGdex doesn't cover B3a and the wiki type cell is blank; Mega Altaria ex is Psychic in all its other printings (B1 102/259/286).
